verdict.rationale: Aleph's own docs claim versioned forecasts and scenario modeling (aleph-docs-3), and list audit logs among its security controls (aleph-docs-25). Together these suggest scenarios are versioned and changes are logged. However, nothing ties those audit logs to scenario assumptions, and no evidence shows per-scenario assumption records or who-changed-what attribution in a scenario comparison. missing for 10: explicit per-scenario assumption tracking, user-level change attribution on scenario assumptions, an auditable scenario comparison view, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
